other_conditions: Employment must be in a private‑sector industry or establishment.
Apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 is eligible for stipend reimbursement.
Candidates who complete apprenticeship and are hired permanently are eligible for salary reimbursement.
SC/ST candidates are eligible for skill development training organized by the Department of Skill Development.
benefits_summary: Employers receive reimbursements for ESI/EPF contributions, apprenticeship stipends, and salaries of SC/ST candidates, along with support for skill‑development training.
documents_required: List of EPF numbers of the employees
